title: TAI crop-yield semantic acceptance repair
objective: Eliminate the false-negative broad live acceptance for a substantive answer about declining winter-wheat yield by validating independent crop-yield factor groups rather than narrow literal stems.
boundaries: Do not change production model behavior, prompts, API routing, security controls, authorization, tenant isolation, write paths or infrastructure
Do not weaken source, model identity, answer mode, stream completion, subject relevance, minimum answer length, forbidden-platform-article, RU/EN/ZH or mobile Chromium assertions
The winter-wheat yield scenario must require at least two independent factor groups among nutrition, water and climate, soil condition, crop health, agronomy and genetics, and field history
Multiple nutrient names count as one nutrition group and multiple weather words count as one water-climate group
The substantive production answer naming nutrient deficiency, moisture or temperature conditions and soil state must pass without requiring unrelated disease, weed or variety words
The validator remains fail-closed and must preserve the actual answer in evidence before any failure

Production completion requires exact-head terminal PASS, merge, exact-main full-stack REG.RU release, controller sync, preflight, protected activation, all 21 endpoint and 5 mobile cases PASS, finalization accept, standalone TAI deployment and postflight PASS
